A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CoPRS and contain 20 readable pages, including Appendices A–C. Text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v2 reports original CoPRS experiments on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, RefCOCOg, and ReasonSeg, together with correlation analyses, ablations, and efficiency measurements.

after.justification: v3 retains original benchmark results, correlation analyses, backbone and training ablations, and qualitative success and failure cases.

M1.justification: The concentration token, heatmap generation, decoder, joint GRPO/segmentation objectives, and training/inference procedures remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix B. Algorithm 1 is identical.

E1.justification: Both versions train and evaluate on the same RefCOCO series and evaluate zero-shot on ReasonSeg. Removing the efficiency comparison does not remove a dataset or task scenario. Referring tracking and trajectory prediction are not experimentally evaluated in either version.

E2.justification: v3 removes the dedicated efficiency comparison against Seg-R1 and Seg-Zero at 3B and 7B scales in v2 Tables 6–7. These comparators remain in the unchanged main benchmark comparisons. Newly cited CD-ViTO and ObjectRelator are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The dedicated parameter-count/GFLOP evaluation using shared Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B backbones disappears with v2 Appendix B.4. Retained experiments preserve their splits, leakage exclusions, IoU metrics, preprocessing, model configurations, and training/inference settings; no rerun or revised setting is reported.

E4.justification: v3 removes the four-bin analysis relating CoT consistency to mean heatmap/mask IoU in v2 Table 3 and the inference-efficiency analysis in Appendix B.4. Correlation scatterplots, backbone and training ablations, and success/failure case studies remain.

E5.justification: The OLS regression bands, their eta=10 scaling, and analysis sample sizes in Figures 3–4 remain unchanged. Neither version reports benchmark uncertainty across repeated runs or seeds. The removed consistency-bin counts describe sample groups, not experimental replication.

E6.justification: v3 removes Table 3's binned results, including mask mIoUs 0.55, 0.78, 0.90, and 0.94, and Tables 6–7's compute results, including CoPRS-3B/7B GFLOPs of 9551.52/22283.68. The latter tables' accuracy values remain in Table 2. Main benchmark scores and retained ablation/correlation results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8, the PPO/GRPO formulations in Appendix A.1 (Equations 9–12), and Algorithm 1 retain the same mathematics. Equation relocation does not introduce or remove definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same central claims about the interpretable positional-prior interface, unified training, benchmark performance, and reasoning–segmentation alignment. Removing supporting tables does not alter these claims.

C2.justification: v3 removes Appendix B.4's interpretation that CoPRS improves accuracy at comparable parameter counts and inference costs. The introduction also drops referring tracking as a suggested extension. Interpretations of correlation, decoder refinement, and resolution/crowd failure modes remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces a future code/checkpoint/log release promise with a code-release statement and repository URL; the reproducibility statement drops its future release promise. Appendix B.1–B.3 implementation details remain unchanged, while the comparative compute disclosures disappear. The PDFs establish the access announcement, not the repository's contents.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds CD-ViTO (Fu et al., 2024) and substitutes ObjectRelator (Fu et al., 2025) for GLaMM in one related-work list, adding two bibliography entries. GLaMM remains cited and evaluated elsewhere. The broader research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 adds publication and corresponding-author information, updates contact text, adds acknowledgments, and makes limited deletions and cross-reference updates. The narrative structure remains stable. One shortened introduction sentence becomes grammatically incomplete: 'we convert this query the positional prior'.

P2.justification: v3 deletes the compact tables numbered 3, 6, and 7 in v2. Backbone Tables 4–5 become Tables 3–4, with the vision-backbone table moving from page 10 to page 9. Headers, link styling, and float placement change, but all eight figure graphics are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 provides a useful code-access pointer, but removes the unique comparative GFLOP evidence in Appendix B.4 and the binned CoT summary in Table 3. Main results and correlation figures remain, limiting the scientific loss. The PDFs do not establish the completeness or usability of the announced release, so its reproducibility benefit cannot reliably be weighed against the reduced documented evidence.
